comment: The ArtCraft edition of Mihawk OS. docs/ARCHITECTURE.md says what each field drives and why.

title.name: ArtCraft
title.comment: The fork's tools (console-setup.py, gate.py, pack-runtime.py, package-install.py) and ShadowMountPlus all name PPSA99170, so the edition takes that slot and replaces MihawkOS on the console. A tile of its own beside MihawkOS needs a new id here and those tools taught to read it (docs/ROADMAP.md).
